# Dun-Rite Seamless Gutters, Inc.

> Gutter company in Madison, Mississippi, founded by Mark Dungan in 1996. Installs seamless aluminum and hand-soldered copper gutters, gutter guards and downspouts, and repairs and cleans gutters in 14 cities across the greater Jackson metro area.

## Business Information

- Name: Dun-Rite Seamless Gutters, Inc. (also searched as Dunrite Gutters, Dun-Rite Gutters)
- Owner: Mark Dungan
- Founded: 1996
- Address: 115 Cherrybrook Dr, Madison, MS 39110
- Phone: (601) 750-1800
- Email: mark.dungan@yahoo.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8 AM – 5 PM (Sat–Sun closed)
- Website: https://dunrite-gutters.com
- Credentials: Mississippi-licensed corporation; Workers' Compensation and General Liability insurance; BBB accredited; HomeAdvisor approved; Home Builders Association member
- Warranty: 25-year manufacturer warranty on materials; 2-year labor warranty on every installation
- Estimates: free, measured on site, written; most scheduled within 48 hours
- Travel: no travel fees within the 14-city service area (roughly a 30-mile radius of Madison)
- Financing: none in-house; major credit cards accepted

## Services

- [Seamless Gutter Installation](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/seamless-gutter-installation/): 5-inch and 6-inch K-style, .032 gauge aluminum, formed on site. $1,200–$3,500 for most homes; 1 day for most single-story homes.
- [Aluminum Gutters](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/aluminum-gutters/): .032, .040 and .050 gauge; nine stocked colors, 25+ available. 20–30 year service life.
- [Copper Gutters](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/copper-gutters/): hand-soldered seams; 16, 20 and 24 oz copper; half-round, K-style, ogee, custom. $25–$40 per linear foot installed.
- [Gutter Guards & Leaf Protection](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/gutter-guards/): fine mesh $10–$14, large-hole screen $7–$10, foam inserts $3–$6 per linear foot installed.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/gutter-cleaning/): hand debris removal, downspout flushing, written photo report. $150–$300 per cleaning; recurring plans 15–25% less.
- [Gutter Repair & Replacement](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/gutter-repair-replacement/): $150–$600 per section; full replacement from $1,200; insurance claim documentation.
- [Commercial Gutters](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/commercial-gutters/): 7-inch and 8-inch profiles for office, retail, multi-family and industrial buildings; AIA-formatted billing on request.
- [Custom Downspouts](https://dunrite-gutters.com/services/custom-downspouts/): round, 3x4 and 4x5 profiles; underground drainage tie-ins $300–$800 per run.

## Service Areas

- [All 14 cities](https://dunrite-gutters.com/service-areas/): Madison (home base), Ridgeland, Gluckstadt, Canton, Jackson, Clinton, Raymond, Bolton, Terry, Flowood, Pearl, Brandon, Richland, Florence.

## About

Mark Dungan founded Dun-Rite Seamless Gutters, Inc. in Madison, Mississippi in 1996. He personally inspects every estimate and supervises every commercial installation, working with a small team of long-tenured installers. The company's specialty is hand-soldered copper gutter work.
